items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 32:1
items.html: The level of Nefesh that the fetus receives while it is in the inclusion of the coupling of Ima comprises these three lights, since the essence of the level is in the middle line, as is known, and it includes the two lights Tifferet and Yesod, included one within the other, while the root of the level is the light of Hesed, which is the secret of ‘the day that goes with all the days.’ And one should not ask, then why seven months? For by way of inclusion, the correction of all seven lights rises from them. (Item 8).
